The issue was that `isinstance(obj, _SupportsRead)` checks in `src/requests/models.py` were insufficient for proxy objects that might not correctly respond to `isinstance` but do have a `read` method. **Changes:**
- Modified `src/requests/models.py` line 164: Updated `isinstance(data, _SupportsRead)` to `isinstance(data, _SupportsRead) or hasattr(data, "read")`.
- Modified `src/requests/models.py` line 644: Updated `isinstance(data, basestring) or isinstance(data, _SupportsRead)` to `isinstance(data, basestring) or isinstance(data, _SupportsRead) or hasattr(data, "read")`.
